title: Data / AI Architect & Governance Analyst
description: Job Family : Data Engineering & Architecture Consulting Travel Required : Up to 10% Clearance Required : Ability to Obtain Public Trust What You Will Do: Evaluate current-state data architecture, data governance frameworks, integration patterns, ownership models, and data quality practices to identify gaps and improvement opportunities. Assess enterprise data ecosystems and recommend strategies to improve interoperability, accessibility, reliability, and stewardship of organizational data assets. Design target-state data architectures that support analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and emerging data-driven capabilities. Develop and enhance data governance frameworks, including policies, standards, processes, roles, and accountability models. Define data domains, ownership structures, stewardship responsibilities, and governance operating models to support enterprise data management. Analyze data flows, system interfaces, and integration patterns to improve data sharing and consistency across platforms. Support the development of data quality strategies, controls, metrics, and remediation approaches to improve trust in enterprise data. Collaborate with business, technology, and leadership stakeholders to align data architecture and governance initiatives with organizational objectives. Support data modernization, digital transformation, and AI enablement efforts through architecture assessments, roadmap development, and implementation planning. Develop executive briefings, recommendations, governance artifacts, and strategic roadmaps to guide data and AI investments. What You Will Need : Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Data Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in data architecture, data governance, data management, analytics, or related disciplines. Experience evaluating and designing enterprise data architectures, data governance programs, or data management frameworks. Understanding of data governance principles, including data ownership, stewardship, metadata management, data quality, and master data management. Experience assessing and documenting data flows, integration architectures, and business data requirements. Knowledge of data warehousing, cloud-based data platforms, data integration technologies, and analytics environments. Familiarity with AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics concepts and the underlying data requirements needed to support them. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused recommendations. Experience developing architecture diagrams, governance artifacts, strategic roadmaps, and executive presentations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and experience working with cross-functional stakeholders. What Would Be Nice To Have: Master's degree in Data Science, Information Management, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Professional certifications in data management, governance, architecture, or cloud technologies (e.g., CDMP, DAMA, DCAM, TOGAF, AWS, Azure, Databricks). Experience establishing or maturing enterprise data governance organizations, councils, stewardship programs, or data operating models. Experience supporting AI governance, responsible AI frameworks, model governance, or AI readiness assessments. Knowledge of metadata management, data catalog, data lineage, master data management (MDM), and data quality platforms. Experience supporting large-scale data modernization, cloud migration, or enterprise analytics transformation programs. Experience with federal government, financial services, or highly regulated environments. Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks and strategic data management best practices. Experience developing data strategies, governance roadmaps, and implementation plans for executive leadership. Knowledge of privacy, cybersecurity, records management, and regulatory requirements related to enterprise data management. The annual salary range for this position is $130,000.00-$216,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. title: Security GRC Lead, Governance Engineering
description: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. Job Category Enterprise Technology & Infrastructure Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. Role Overview We are looking for a technically strong Security Governance professional who can bridge the gap between Security & Compliance requirements and Engineering implementation. This role will serve as the technical voice and face of Assurance. You will partner closely with Engineering organizations, PCLs, Product Security, Legal, and other stakeholders to understand how security and compliance requirements are implemented in real systems. You will identify what is working and what is not, and translate those insights back into practical, scalable governance requirements. The successful candidate will understand systems and architectures deeply enough to move beyond validating whether a control exists. They will evaluate how the control is designed, implemented, operated, and scaled across the enterprise. Key Responsibilities: Bridge Assurance and Engineering - Serve as a technical liaison between Assurance, Engineering, Product Security, PCLs, Legal, and other stakeholders, ensuring governance requirements are technically feasible, understandable, and implementable. Evaluate Control Implementation - Work directly with Engineering teams to understand how security and compliance controls are implemented within applications, platforms, infrastructure, cloud environments, and engineering workflows. Create the Engineering Feedback Loop - Assess what is working, what is creating unnecessary friction, and where controls or requirements are unclear or difficult to operationalize. Feed those insights back into control design, standards, and governance processes. Make Requirements Engineer-Usable - Translate regulatory, compliance, and security expectations into clear, actionable technical requirements that Engineering teams can consistently implement and validate. Develop Second-Line Oversight - Develop second-line oversight protocols that independently monitor, audit, and validate that all security controls are operational across engineering teams in Salesforce (e.g., attestations, CRE checks). Understand Systems End-to-End - Develop a deep understanding of key platforms, architectures, engineering processes, security capabilities, and control implementations to help Assurance make better risk and compliance decisions. Assess Risk in M&A - Assess control and risk exposure during M&As. Design the assessment to price risk, evaluate compatibility, and deliver an executable activation plan tied back to the risk model. Partner on Emerging Security Requirements - Collaborate with Product Security, Legal, PCEs, Market Enablement, and other teams to understand emerging requirements and determine how they should translate into future security controls and engineering expectations. Track the Direction of Compliance Frameworks - Monitor where regulatory and compliance expectations are heading, including AI governance, the EU AI Act, evolving international requirements, and market-specific regulatory expectations. Proactively identify implications for the organization. Drive Change Management and Enablement - Build the change management, training, and communication needed to shift teams from "go find and interpret a policy" to "know precisely what applies and how to comply." Run Control Incident Management - Stand up a formal incident management practice for control failures. Include postmortems, root-cause analysis, and error budgets for controls, modeled on availability incident response. Influence Future Control Design - Partner with control owners and technical teams to evolve controls based on new technologies, regulatory expectations, architecture changes, and lessons learned from implementation. Drive Security Champion Engagement - Build strong relationships with technical stakeholders across Engineering. Establish a network of security/control champions who can provide implementation feedback, promote requirements, and help scale governance across teams. Report to Executive Leadership - Report on control reliability, coverage, pressure, and systemic risk trends to executive leadership. We're investing in a stronger data foundation, expanding our analytical capabilities, and building toward AI-enabled talent intelligence. We are now looking for a People Data Analyst who can take business questions from concept to delivery: building analytics-ready data, developing meaningful analytical solutions, and partnering directly with stakeholders to turn insights into action. Reporting to the Director, People Transformation and Analytics, you'll work across the employee lifecycle, including headcount, attrition and retention, internal mobility, performance, compensation, and engagement. Design, develop, and maintain analytical solutions, including Tableau and Databricks dashboards, AI-powered applications, conversational interfaces, and automated insight delivery through platforms such as Microsoft Teams and email. Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance by maintaining trusted metric definitions, performing accuracy checks, and protecting sensitive employee information through appropriate privacy and access controls. Hands-on experience with modern cloud data platforms such as Databricks or Snowflake, with Databricks strongly preferred. Experience in analytics data modeling, including designing and building curated, analysis-ready datasets and tables for reporting and downstream analytical applications. Proven ability to build production-ready dashboards and BI solutions from the ground up using Tableau, Databricks AI/BI Dashboards, Power BI, or comparable platforms, with an understanding of calculated fields, performance optimization, and governance. Strong data visualization and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly and tailor insights to different audiences. Excellent stakeholder management, consulting, and communication skills, including the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into practical analytical solutions and provide recommendations. Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently, challenge assumptions, and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
